title: A boat may rise with the tide, but a rising tide does not necessarily lift every boat
section_path: A boat may rise with the tide, but a rising tide does not necessarily lift every boat
section_path_text: A boat may rise with the tide, but a rising tide does not necessarily lift every boat
summary:
Main
By Michalis Voutsinas
A boat may rise with the tide, but a rising tide does not necessarily lift every boat. The same asymmetry is increasingly apparent in global trade, where the expansion of international commerce is being driven by forces whose implications for the underlying industrial economy remain far from uniform. Artificial intelligence is catalysing an unprecedented investment cycle in digital infrastructure, reshaping trade flows and lifting headline growth projections, while geopolitical conflict is disrupting the supply of essential resources and raising production costs.
